chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Rifāʿah, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who does not know whether he has prayed one rakʿah or two. He said: He repeats.

key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the person asking about his case in prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَةً: one rakʿah; a single unit of salat (prayer)
key_terms.لَا يَدْرِي: does not know; is uncertain or in doubt
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he repeats; he must perform the prayer again

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts whether he has prayed one rakʿah or two?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer), specifically uncertainty between one rakʿah and two. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام rules that the prayer must be repeated, indicating the seriousness of uncertainty in the first two rakʿahs.
